Register for the {{1}} at {{2}}, Switzerland.

templates.pat: By integration with the {{1}} and {{2}}, all software dependencies of each workflow step are automatically deployed upon execution.
templates.zh: 通过与 {{1}} 和 {{2}} 集成，每个工作流步骤的所有软件依赖都会在执行时自动部署。

templates.pat: Rapidly implement analysis steps via direct {{1}} and {{2}} supporting Python, R, Julia, Rust, Bash, without requiring any boilerplate code.
templates.zh: 通过直接的 {{1}} 与 {{2}}，支持 Python、R、Julia、Rust、Bash，无需任何样板代码即可快速实现分析步骤。

templates.pat: Easily create and employ re-usable {{1}}, split your data analysis into well-separated {{2}}, and compose multi-modal analyses by easily {{3}} various sources.
templates.zh: 轻松创建并使用可复用的{{1}}，把数据分析拆分成彼此分离的{{2}}，还能{{3}}，从而组合来自不同来源的多模态分析。

templates.pat: Being a syntactical extension of {{1}}, you can implement arbitrary logic beyond the plain definition of rules. Rules can be generated conditionally, arbitrary Python logic can be used to perform aggregations, configuration and metadata can be obtained and postprocessed in any required way.
templates.zh: 作为 {{1}} 的语法扩展，你可以在规则定义之外实现任意逻辑：规则可以有条件地生成，可以用任意 Python 逻辑完成聚合，配置与元数据也可以按需获取并进一步处理。

templates.pat: The logic of production workflows can become complex by involving lots of lookups and dynamic decisions. Snakemake offers {{1}} for lookups, branching and aggregation that avoid the need for plain Python code as shown above, and allow to express complex logic in a human-readable and self-contained way.
templates.zh: 生产工作流的逻辑常常因为大量查表与动态决策而变得复杂。Snakemake 提供{{1}}来完成查表、分支与聚合，无需像上面那样写裸 Python 代码，从而以人类可读、自包含的方式表达复杂逻辑。

templates.pat: Snakemake allows to define workflows that are dynamically updated at runtime. By defining so-called {{1}}, the workflow can be dynamically adapted at runtime. Further, input can be provided as {{2}}, thereby enabling a workflow to continuously receive new input data (e.g. while a certain measurement is conducted).
templates.zh: Snakemake 允许定义在运行时动态更新的工作流：通过定义所谓的{{1}}，工作流可以在运行中动态调整；输入还可以通过 {{2}}提供，使工作流能够持续接收新的输入数据（例如在某项测量进行期间）。

templates.pat: Automatic, interactive, self-contained {{1}} ensure full transparency from results down to used steps, parameters, code, and software. The reports can moreover contain embedded results (from images, to PDFs and even {{2}}) enabling a comprehensive reporting that combines analysis results with data provenance information.
templates.zh: 自动、交互、自包含的{{1}}可确保从结果到所用步骤、参数、代码与软件的完全透明。报告还可以内嵌结果（从图片到 PDF，甚至{{2}}），从而把分析结果与数据溯源信息合并成一份完整的报告。

templates.pat: Workflows {{1}} seamlessly from single to multicore, clusters or the cloud, without modification of the workflow definition and automatic avoidance of redundant computations.
templates.zh: 工作流可以从单机无缝{{1}}到多核、集群或云端，无需修改工作流定义，并自动避免冗余计算。

templates.pat: Snakemake is extremely flexible and configurable. Numerous {{1}} allow adapt the behavior to the needs of the data analysis at hand and the underlying infrastructure. Options can be provided via the command line interface or persisted via system-wide, user-specific, and workflow specific {{2}}.
templates.zh: Snakemake 极其灵活且可配置。众多{{1}}可让行为适配手头的数据分析需求与底层基础设施；选项可以通过命令行界面提供，也可以保存在系统级、用户级与工作流级的{{2}}中。

templates.pat: Snakemake has a powerful {{1}} that allows to extend various functionalities with alternative implementations. Via stable and well-defined interfaces, plugins can evolve independently of Snakemake, and mutual update requirements are minimized. Currently, execution backends and remote storage support is implemented via plugins. In the future, we will extend this to other areas, such as workflow scheduling, reporting, software deployment, and more.
templates.zh: Snakemake 拥有强大的{{1}}，可以用替代实现扩展各种功能。借助稳定、定义良好的接口，插件可以独立于 Snakemake 演进，相互之间的更新要求降到最低。目前执行后端与远程存储支持都通过插件实现；未来这一机制将扩展到工作流调度、报告、软件部署等更多领域。

templates.pat: This catalog collects information about and documentation of all Snakemake plugins published on {{1}}. Note that plugin support is available in {{2}} and later. Via plugins, Snakemake enables users and developers to extend the core functionality, e.g. by providing backends for execution and storage, or supporting different ways of logging or scheduling. Via stable, concise, and well documented semantically versioned interfaces, plugin evolution can happen independently of the main Snakemake codebase. The following illustration depicts the general architecture of Snakemake and its plugin interfaces:
templates.zh: 本目录收集了发布在 {{1}} 上的所有 Snakemake 插件的信息与文档。注意插件支持从 {{2}} 起可用。借助插件，用户与开发者可以扩展核心功能，例如提供执行与存储后端，或支持不同的日志与调度方式。通过稳定、简洁且有完整文档的语义化版本接口，插件的演进可以独立于 Snakemake 主代码库。下图展示了 Snakemake 及其插件接口的整体架构：
